Respondents  Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased to pass an order or orders particularly one in.

the nature of Writ of  Mandamus declaring the action of the official respondent Nos.2 to 5 in disbursing the land acquisition compensation amount in favour, of unofficial respondent without considering our objections and claims dated 28.05.2025 and 12.09.2024 for the land to an extent of 1182.41 square yards comprising of Ac.0.42 cents in Sy.No. 152/1 for construction of limited height sub-way (Railway under pass) at Palamaneru-Krishnagiri Road, Kuppam Village and Mandal as illegal, irregular, arbitrary and violations of the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, The Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 and Rules framed there under and also offends Articles 14, 21 and 300 A of Constitution of India and consequently direct the officials respondents not to disburse compensation amount of Rs.79,19,354/- in favour of the unofficial respondent for acquisition of land in an extent of 1182.41 square yards comprising of Ac.0.42 cents in Sy.No. 152/1 for construction of the limited height sub-way in Kuppam (Railway line underpass at KM 7/10 of Palamaneru-Krishnagiri Road, Kuppam Village and Mandal).
